tournament.name: August OCC Qualifier - Bracket B
tournament.description:
Welcome August OCC Qualifiers! If you are one of the Top 38 (40) from the July Officer's Club ranking and have received an email about the tournament, please confirm your participation in the upcoming tournament by August 13th. Full dock of OCC FAQs: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1hXc4fBobUsFAtis1Cr3HsGu37QCq6aR87T1PmZIwi3Y/edit?usp=sharing

OCC AUGUST SCHEDULE: Qualifier Brackets - August 14th @ 1300 GMT (deck list deadline August 14th @ 1200 GMT) - The qualifier brackets are seeded based on the position of the player on the OC leader-board at the end of the season. Round of 8 Finals - August 22nd @ 1300 GMT (deck list deadline August 19th @ 2300 GMT) -The Round of 8 Finals are seeded based on OC leaderboard at the end of the season in addition to the final 2 qualified players being positioned in #7 and #8.
